title: Interview Practice Deck
creator: Beth Kullberg
subject: College Admissions
description: Practice answering 24 common college interview questions out loud, with a timer, likely follow-ups, and a quick self-check.

learningObjectives: Students will practice answering common college interview questions aloud and demonstrate answers that use a specific example and stay within a natural length.

controls: Next question, Start answering, Stop, and Follow-up buttons

keyQuestions: Why do memorized answers sound worse than practiced stories?
What makes a good question to ask an interviewer?
How can a follow-up question help you?
commonMisconceptions: Interviews are tests with right answers.
assessmentOpportunities: Students answer three questions in under two minutes each, using a specific example and saying why it matters to them.
